proposals.name: Protecting Renters Ordinance (PRO)
proposals.text_reviewed: As introduced (June 2026). The substitute advanced on 2026-09-16 was not reviewed line by line. Check every proposed version against the final text before it becomes law.

history.event: Introduced to City Council and sent to the Committee on Housing and Real Estate.
Committee on Housing and Real Estate advanced a substitute, 12-9. Just cause for non-renewal and related relocation payments were removed.
Full City Council vote deferred again.

proposals.name: Fair and Accountable Illinois Rental Ordinance (FAIR)
proposals.text_reviewed: Not reviewed. Press reports say FAIR shares most RLTO updates with PRO (deposit cap, repair-and-deduct, retaliation, lockouts) but has no Tenant Bill of Rights or new bureau, a smaller registry, and allows some move-in fees.

history.event: Introduced to City Council as an alternative to PRO.
Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards advanced it, 12-6.
